name: Brier
overview: In Scripture, briers symbolize judgment, rebellion, and hardship. Isaiah 5:6 portrays briers arising as a consequence of neglect and divine judgment, while Ezekiel 2:6 uses briers metaphorically to represent the rebellious people among whom the prophet dwells. However, Isaiah 55:13 offers a hopeful contrast, promising that briers will be replaced by flourishing trees as a sign of God's enduring blessing. Ezekiel 28:24 further emphasizes God's promise to remove the painful briers from Israel, affirming His sovereign care and restoration.
